items.question: Do you furnish both homes and hotels?
items.answer: Yes. We serve homeowners, apartments, hotels, resorts and commercial projects across Nepal — from single-room refreshes to full-property furnishing packages.

items.question: Can I get a custom order for a specific fabric, size or colour?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our custom furnishing solutions let you choose fabric, sizing and colour palettes tailored to your space, taste or brand identity.

items.question: Do you offer delivery and installation?
items.answer: Yes, we handle everything end-to-end — delivery across Pokhara and beyond, plus professional installation by our trained team.

items.question: Do you provide bulk pricing for hotels and resorts?
items.answer: We offer tailored bulk pricing and dedicated consultation for hotel, resort and commercial furnishing projects. Contact us for a custom quote.

items.question: Where is your store located?
items.answer: We're located on New Road, Pokhara 33700, Nepal. Walk-ins are always welcome during business hours.

items.question: How can I request a quote?
items.answer: Use the Get a Quote button to message us on WhatsApp, fill out our contact form, or call us directly — we typically respond within the same business day.
